latest.title: Breathing and moving vesicles in a geometric mechanochemical model
latest.abstract: We consider a geometric mechanochemical model of vesicles which couples the Helfrich flow for the shape of a lipid bilayer vesicle membrane $X$ with a reaction-diffusion equations for a single ``morphogen'' $φ$ on $X$. The Helfrich flow is the $L^2$ gradient flow of the elastic bending energy $E(X)=\int_X (H-c_0)^2 dS$ of $X$, typically supplemented by area or volume constraints, or both. The morphogen $φ$ adsorbs/desorbs at places of high/low mean curvature $H$, i.e., the kinetics of $φ$ depend on $H$, and conversely $φ$ modifies the spontaneous curvature $c_0$ on $X$. The flow is no longer gradient, and hence allows for more complicated dynamics, including time periodic orbits, e.g., ``breathing and moving'' vesicle shapes. We show how to compute bifurcation diagrams for such solution branches via numerical continuation and bifurcation methods. We mostly focus on ``planar'' vesicles (1D closed curves) but also give an outlook on 3D vesicles (2D closed membranes).
latest.workSummary: 论文研究带 Helfrich 弯曲能与曲率耦合反应扩散的几何 mechanochemical vesicle 模型，重点是平面闭曲线并辅以二维球面的展望。作者推导曲线形状、形态变量和约束乘子的耦合演化，先用线性化谱和对称性识别从圆到波数 m 分支的 pitchfork/transcritical bifurcation，再以 pde2path 的 arclength continuation 跟踪稳态、相对稳态和 Hopf 产生的周期轨道；DNS 显示 breathing/moving vesicle、漂移、触发波和自交失效。全文以数值延拓和直接模拟为主，没有独立的 theorem/lemma proof chain。
latest.breakthrough: 展示形态变量反馈如何把平面 vesicle 的稳态分支推进为呼吸与移动周期轨道，并给出可复现的数值延拓框架来追踪对称破缺和 Hopf 分岔。
latest.limitations: 结论主要来自离散化、数值延拓和 DNS，周期轨道稳定性及自交后的模型失效没有被解析证明；参数区间、网格质量和对称性选择影响分支图，三维曲面只作展望，不能把数值分支当作一般存在定理。
latest.aiEvidence: 逐页检查摘要、模型推导、Sections 2–4、数值算法、图注、讨论、致谢和参考文献，并检索 AI、LLM、ChatGPT、Claude、OpenAI、generative 等词；未见作者明确披露 AI/LLM 用于研究或论文制作。
latest.priorityReason: 论文聚焦椭圆与抛物方程，主要进展属于近似与数值分析；排序综合考虑其与 PDE 机制、可复用估计、正则性和长时间行为的相关程度。
